purpose: Record the guarded one-request TaskManager three-residual repair probe and post-run audit
diff_scope: Outer task-list dragover changed from an empty handler to on-dragover="prevent:noop", with exported component noop() method.
The original isOverdue date calculation moved to isOverdueHelper; computed and statistics call the helper, while the component method delegates to it.
Template passes tasks explicitly to getTaskCount(tasks, filter.value); the method delegates to a helper that uses the supplied array instead of hiding a this.data.get('tasks') read.
conclusion: The focused development probe resolves the three reported residual errors without an observed regression in the bounded checks. It is not a fresh source-to-San batch or independent formal-test result. A new frozen development batch and browser interaction review remain necessary before pipeline-level acceptance.
